statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH / yellow. Monday finished with a record Nasdaq close and broad technology strength, but fresh granular NQ price-path structure after the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen is not yet independently verified at the assessment cutoff.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold because the prior strong session is not yet confirmed as a persistent post-reopen path; the next major conditional checkpoint is Tuesday's U.S. cash open and Federal Reserve speaker sequence.
headline: Globex reopens after a powerful tech-led close, with Tail held at WATCH pending fresh path evidence
body: Monday's Nasdaq record close, 4.3% semiconductor-index gain, lower oil and softer long Treasury yields leave a strongly aligned prior-session backdrop. Fresh supplementary breadth, megacap and semiconductor context is also positive but non-real-time. Because granular post-reopen NQ pullback quality is not yet verified, Tail remains below the blocking band while Stress stays extreme.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail moved from WATCH and low overnight into elevated/high during the U.S. session, peaked at 38% in power hour, then fell to low during the 21:00 UTC CME maintenance interruption.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 24% / watch at the Globex reopen because Monday's one-way strength is not yet verified as continuing in fresh granular NQ structure. Overnight risk stays low-to-watch absent persistent failed retracements. The principal conditional danger window is 13:30–15:30 UTC Tuesday around the cash open and Williams/Jefferson remarks; Barkin and power hour are later checkpoints.

forecast.analysis: Observed: Monday ended with a record Nasdaq close, broad megacap and semiconductor strength, lower oil and a softer 10-year yield. Fresh granular NQ structure after the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen is not yet independently verified, so Tail remains at WATCH rather than a blocking band.
drivers: Lower oil and softer long yields
Post-reopen NQ structure not yet verified

forecast.analysis: Conditional: in the second post-reopen hour, Tail stays at WATCH if futures remain close to prior extremes without enough evidence of repeated failed retracements. Ordinary two-way rotation would push the path back toward low Tail.

Conditional: the early overnight baseline returns to low Tail if the reopened range contains both advances and meaningful pullbacks. A clean break that resists retracement would invalidate the low-Tail case.
Conditional: early Asia remains low Tail while directional efficiency is ordinary. Thin liquidity raises uncertainty more readily than Tail unless extensions repeatedly follow failed pullbacks.
Conditional: Asia stays low Tail if pullbacks continue to interrupt direction. Persistent fresh extremes with little retracement would be the main escalation signal.
Conditional: late Asia remains low Tail while price discovery is two-way. A sequence of failed retracements would matter more than headline volatility by itself.
Conditional: the Asia-Europe handoff remains low Tail unless NQ breaks an overnight extreme and sustains that move without meaningful retracement.
Conditional: early Europe remains low Tail if price discovery stays balanced. Cross-asset alignment matters only if NQ simultaneously develops persistent directional structure.
Conditional: European hours keep Tail low while ordinary retracements remain visible. A one-way move through overnight extremes would lift the next-hour risk path.
Conditional: mid-Europe risk stays low if breadth and futures do not align into persistent extension. Renewed near-extreme holding would move Tail toward WATCH.
Conditional: late-Europe Tail moves to WATCH as U.S. participation approaches. The score rises only if directional structure begins to persist rather than because the clock advances.
Conditional: U.S. premarket risk remains WATCH if the prior record close attracts renewed extension. Meaningful retracement and mixed leadership would keep Tail contained.

Conditional: premarket Tail stays WATCH while the evidence is still prospective. A widening gap plus aligned semiconductors, megacaps and rates would matter only if NQ also shows persistent extension.
drivers: Rates confirmation if NQ also persists

forecast.analysis: Conditional: the hour before the cash open keeps WATCH because opening-auction structure is still unobserved. A balanced premarket range would argue against escalation.

Conditional: approaching the 13:30 UTC cash open, Stress rises on event and opening uncertainty while Tail remains WATCH until actual continuation, shallow pullbacks or failed retracements are observed.
drivers: Speaker sequence later in the session

forecast.analysis: Conditional: around the cash open, Tail enters the elevated band only if the prior technology-led regime carries into the opening auction with near-extreme holding and weak retracements. A normal opening rotation would de-escalate it.

Conditional: Williams and Jefferson are scheduled during this hour. Their remarks raise Stress, but Tail reaches 31% only if the market response becomes persistently one-way with repeated failed retracements; orderly two-way discovery would reduce it.

Conditional: after the speaker sequence, Tail stays elevated only if directional extension persists. Clear retracement, volatility decay and cross-asset stabilization would pull the score back toward WATCH.
Conditional: midday Tail returns to WATCH if the morning move has developed meaningful rotation. Renewed extension after failed pullbacks would keep elevated risk alive.
Conditional: Barkin is scheduled to speak at 17:00 UTC. The event raises Stress, while the 25% Tail case requires a persistent directional response rather than the speech itself.
drivers: Directional response required for elevated Tail

forecast.analysis: Conditional: early afternoon Tail is WATCH if price discovery remains two-way after the policy checkpoints. A fresh one-way break would be the escalation trigger.
Conditional: power hour carries elevated Tail only if NQ holds near session extremes and extends after shallow or failed pullbacks. A broader rotation would invalidate the elevated path.
Conditional: after the cash close, Tail falls toward WATCH if late-session continuation does not carry into futures. Persistent post-close extension would keep risk higher.

Conditional: the 21:00 UTC CME maintenance period interrupts continuous futures price discovery. Tail is low during the interruption; prior-session strength remains context rather than an observed path in this hour.

forecastDetail.comment: Current WATCH reflects a strong prior close but no independently verified granular post-reopen NQ path yet.
Second-hour WATCH is conditional on near-extreme holding without enough repeated failed-retracement evidence for a block.
Low Tail assumes the reopened range develops normal two-way rotation and meaningful pullbacks.
Early-Asia low Tail requires ordinary directional efficiency; thin liquidity alone mainly affects uncertainty.
Asia remains low Tail unless fresh extremes repeatedly follow shallow or failed pullbacks.
Late-Asia low Tail assumes two-way discovery; repeated failed retracements are the escalation condition.
